name: Cloud Modernization Programme
businessProblem: Legacy commerce platforms slow product launches and create costly seasonal scaling risk.
targetTimeline: Mobilise in October 2026 and complete before the 2027 spring campaign.
budgetAssumptions: A blended team of 8–10 people with cloud consumption funded separately.
notes: Customer prefers incremental migration and visible value within the first six weeks.

name: Responsible AI Adoption Accelerator
businessProblem: Teams are experimenting with generative AI without a shared operating model or reusable delivery patterns.
targetTimeline: Pilot outcomes required in the first quarter of 2027.
budgetAssumptions: Six-person core team with part-time legal and risk specialists.
notes: Executive sponsorship is strong, but use-case ownership needs confirmation.

name: Enterprise Data Platform Modernization
businessProblem: Plant and supply-chain data is fragmented across regional warehouses and spreadsheet reporting.
targetTimeline: First two plants live within four months.
budgetAssumptions: Platform delivery plus three lighthouse data products.
notes: The customer wants a repeatable onboarding pattern for additional plants.

name: Claims Application Modernization
businessProblem: A monolithic claims platform causes release bottlenecks and inconsistent customer communications.
targetTimeline: Release the first modernized claims journey in five months.
budgetAssumptions: Seven-person product team with customer-owned test and compliance support.
notes: Integration with the existing policy administration system is the critical dependency.

name: Customer Service Transformation
businessProblem: Contact-centre agents search multiple systems and struggle to resolve disruption enquiries quickly.
targetTimeline: Pilot before the 2027 summer booking peak.
budgetAssumptions: Five-person delivery team plus customer contact-centre champions.
notes: The initial pilot will cover flight disruption and booking-change scenarios.

name: Cloud Security Uplift
businessProblem: Rapid cloud adoption created inconsistent identity, logging, and workload protection practices.
targetTimeline: Critical controls implemented within one quarter.
budgetAssumptions: Four-person specialist team with workload owners assigned by the customer.
notes: Clinical systems cannot tolerate broad disruptive changes.

name: Modern Workplace Adoption
businessProblem: Field and office teams use collaboration tools inconsistently, limiting knowledge sharing.
targetTimeline: Launch champion programme before year end.
budgetAssumptions: Small adoption team with regional champions supplied by the customer.
notes: Field worker scenarios must remain practical on mobile devices.

name: Engineering Productivity Transformation
businessProblem: Product teams have long lead times, inconsistent pipelines, and limited software delivery insight.
targetTimeline: Pilot platform capabilities with three teams in four months.
budgetAssumptions: Six-person platform enablement team with embedded customer engineers.
notes: The customer wants adoption evidence, not only new tooling.
